description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForm page 'EditTheory'. It handles UI events such as button clicks and dropdown list changes to navigate between pages and populate course selections based on semester and year information. It is part of a web application for online examinations, specifically managing the editing of theory questions or content.
